notes.title: Demo update 24 is now live!
notes.notes:
The latest demo update is here, bringing big improvements to the gameplay experience:

Smoother Player Onboarding – New UI elements and tutorial cues make it easier than ever to jump in and survive your first night.

UI Overhaul – Cleaner visuals and better menus for an improved, more immersive experience.

Expanded Input Support – Better controller support and rebindable keys for maximum comfort.

Train Level Reworks – Updated puzzles, improved pacing, and refined encounters to keep the tension high from start to finish.

Whether you’re a first-time survivor or a returning veteran, now is the perfect time to hop back in and test your skills.

notes.title: Major Demo Update – Fairer Boss, Loadout Rework, and UI Polish!
notes.notes:
The nightmare just got deeper.

This major update to the Necrosis: Dawn of Dread demo brings sharper teeth, better tools for survival, and a new layer of polish to every corner of the experience.

What’s new:

Rebalanced Boss Fight
The first major encounter is still lethal, but is now better balanced. Expect a fairer fight without losing the fear.

Updated Character Loadouts
Every survivor now comes equipped with a light source and a last-resort melee weapon. You're still vulnerable, but never defenseless.

UI and Gameplay Improvements
Menus are cleaner. Interactions are smoother. The world feels more immersive and responsive.

Refined Balance and Pacing
Tension has been adjusted based on community feedback to sharpen the survival experience without dulling the edge.



Step back into the outbreak. The dark is waiting.

notes.title: Demo Update: More Content. More Chaos. No Mercy.
notes.notes:
Necrosis: Dawn of Dread isn't slowing down — it's speeding up. While other games drip-feed patches, we're dropping updates like it's an outbreak. This latest demo build brings new polish, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life upgrades based directly on your feedback.

We're not just refining the experience — we're rewriting the rules of survival horror:

⚔ Combat improvements that make every shot matter

🧠 Smarter zombie behavior — because panic shouldn't be predictable

🔧 Performance boosts and bug fixes to keep the game as smooth as your aim

💀 More polish to visuals, UI, and balance — because we're not shipping anything half-baked

And we’re just getting started. Major updates hit constantly. The outbreak’s evolving fast — and so are we.
Play the demo. Spread the word. Wishlist the game.
Because when the apocalypse hits, you'll want to say you were here first.
